About this data. Staff records come from the district staff establishment return; enrolment comes from the current basic schools enrolment return. School names are matched across both files automatically. This Overview and the Circuits tab reflect the original baseline files; the Schools and Teachers tabs reflect any school updates you've imported via the Updates tab.
